*Team Desk Note — HDFC Bank Update (2026-11-27)*
Topic: HDFC Bank to stop SMS alerts for UPI payments up to ₹500 from January 1, 2027

• This means customers making UPI payments of ₹100, ₹200, ₹400 or ₹500 will not receive an SMS alert from the bank after completing the transaction.

• Under the revised framework, banks must send immediate SMS alerts for electronic banking transactions exceeding ₹500.

keyPoints: Reserve Bank of India accepted bids worth ₹3,680 crore in the planned ₹9,000 crore auction of the 6.20% 2029 paper
The Reserve Bank of India accepted bids worth about 40% of the size of shorter-tenor three-year bonds in an auction on Friday, managing to keep the cutoff yield below 7% handle.
The three-year or 6.20% 2029 bond yield was dealt at 6.9960% in the secondary market before the auction cutoffs, and there were no deals after the auction.

keyPoints: Tokyo's core inflation rises to its highest level since July 2025, while the measure excluding fresh food and energy climbs 2.5%.

Tokyo's consumer prices rose at their fastest pace this year in November, strengthening the case for the Bank of Japan to raise interest rates next month as it works to keep inflation near its 2% target.

Core consumer price index in the capital, which leaves out volatile fresh food, climbed 2.9% from a year earlier, the highest since July 2025, the Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications said on Friday.
